{{Quote|The name's Ogden, munitions recovery&mdash;Lord Karvus's unit. Well&hellip; it was. Lord Karvus is dead. Everyone is.|Ogden|<ref name="Impact Zone" />}}
'''Karvus''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire's]] [[Battle of Corellia|invasion]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Lord Karvus was among the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to assist [[Darth Decimus]] in taking over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. When an Imperial weapons transport was shot down over the park, Karvus led a munitions recovery team to retrieve the craft's newly-designed high-yield explosives. However, Karvus and the team were ambushed and [[Death/Legends|killed]], leaving [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ogden (lieutenant)|Ogden]] the only survivor.
